qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Scale and prequalification advantages in mega-infrastructure, advanced tech (data centers, battery plants via Turner), and toll road concessions (Abertis). However, construction contracting is structurally characterized by competitive bidding, thin operating margins (4-5%), and project execution risks, resulting in GAAP ROIC of 3-6%, well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Global infrastructure contractor and concessionaire (Turner, Hochtief, Abertis) has leading positions in mega-projects and data centers, but thin contracting margins (4-5%) and competitive bidding yield sub-hurdle multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (3-6%).
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins remain structurally thin at ~4.5-5.0%. Consolidated GAAP ROIC sits in the 3-6% range across the cycle, far below the 12% threshold. General contracting inherently lacks pricing power against public and corporate procurement.
